messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a spike in mTLS handshake failures from eu-west services starting ~1777771100. Errors look like KMS unwrap denied + OCSP timeouts.
liam: ugh, is this after the RBAC tighten we rolled at 1769999999?
maya: yeah, rolled the keystore principal scope change at +10m. failures correlate with that window. logs: `unwrap error: AccessDenied` on prod-keystore pods, then `tls: handshake timeout` downstream.
security-bot: ALERT: 5xx rate increased by 18% for service=ingest-eu. Top error signatures: `kms:DecryptAccessDenied`, `tls: unknown CA`, `ocsp: request timed out`.
ops-jen: quick checks: can someone confirm the keystore IAM role still has kms:Decrypt on the regional key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:kms-key/abcd? we changed principals to service accounts last week.
liam: I queried CloudTrail — there are multiple `kms:Decrypt` denies for principal `svc-ingest@redwood` around ts 1777771102. Looks like the RBAC rule removed a role binding in the keystore-controller service account.
maya: we should roll back that RBAC change to unblock traffic. Can we do a scoped rollback (keystore-controller only) vs full policy revert?
paul: scoped rollback seems safe. Patch: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata: {name: keystore-controller-decrypt}
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: keystore-controller
  namespace: infra
roleRef: {kind: Role, name: kms-decrypt, apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io}
EOF`
ops-jen: i'll apply the patch to staging first and validate. can someone run an `auditbot` query to list the recent RBAC mutation?
liam: `auditbot query --since 2h --actor=infra:admin --kind=RoleBinding` shows change id rb-2026-03-23-15. created by deploy/infra-config.
maya: also important — some downstream proxies are rejecting cert chains with `tls: unknown CA`. I suspect our rotator injected a new intermediate cert that's not in proxy trust.
paul: good catch. check cert bundles in proxies: `kubectl exec proxy-eu-0 -- cat /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.pem | grep -A2 "CN=Redwood Intermediate"` — if missing, we need to push updated bundle.
security-bot: NOTE: OCSP responder in eu-west had elevated latency during the window (https://telemetry/ocsp/eu-west 500ms p95). Could have caused clients to treat cert as unverifiable and abort handshake.
liam: mitigation plan: 1) scoped RBAC rollback for keystore-controller (apply patch) 2) restart keystore-controller pods to pick up role binding 3) push cert bundle to proxies if missing 4) enable temporary OCSP soft-fail policy for proxies in eu-west (config snippet below).
maya: config snippet for soft-fail: `tls_profile: { ocsp: { strict: false, timeout_ms: 500 } }` — ops can toggle via configmap `proxy-tls-config`.
ops-jen: applying RBAC patch to staging now. will run smoke after rollout. ETA 8m.
paul: I'll prepare the cert bundle and upload to `s3://redwood-config/eu/proxy-ca-bundle.pem` and create PR to update the DaemonSet.
liam: postmortem pre-notes: root cause hypothesis = RBAC change removed keystore controller principal from kms-decrypt role, causing `unwrap -> AccessDenied` which then surfaced as `tls: unknown CA` once rotator couldn't deliver proper certs; OCSP latency amplified failures.
maya: assigning action items: liam — revert RBAC for keystore-controller and verify KMS decrypt success; ops-jen — coordinate proxy bundle push + temporary soft-fail; paul — audit rotator outputs and ensure rotated chain includes intermediate.
ops-jen: rollout to staging succeeded, smoke passed. about to apply to prod-eu with `kubectl apply -f keystore-rollback.yaml --namespace infra`
security-bot: DEPLOYMENT: keystore-rolebinding rollback applied to prod-eu by ops-jen at ts 1777771135.
liam: just saw `kms:Decrypt` successes after pod restart. ingress metrics returning to baseline.
maya: keeping thread open for 1h to watch for regressions. we should follow up with: - permanent RBAC review (audit + CI gate) - OCSP monitoring thresholds - rotator integration test to verify full chain distribution (inc. intermediates).
paul: noted. opening follow-up tickets and including snippets from this thread in the triage. :thumbsup:
